title: Proximal Optimal Transport Modeling of Population Dynamics
tldr_zh: JKOnet：把 ICNN 求解的 JKO 步当可微模块，双层优化从时序快照反学 potential 能量，单细胞上优于 forward 法
tldr_en: JKOnet treats ICNN-solved JKO steps as differentiable layers and learns the driving potential energy from population snapshots via bilevel optimization with Sinkhorn losses.
key_numbers: Embryoid body scRNA-seq one-step W_eps (day 6-9/12-15/18-21/24-27): JKOnet 0.133/0.133/0.172/0.169 vs Forward 0.187/0.162/0.185/0.203 (Table 1)
Lineage histogram l1 / Hellinger, one-step: JKOnet 88.80 / 0.016 vs Forward 132.27 / 0.026; all-steps: JKOnet 215.60 / 0.034 vs Forward 185.47 / 0.033 (Table 2)
Line extrapolation Sinkhorn divergence validation/test: Forward 1.94 / 26.10 vs JKOnet 2.90 / 20.30 (Table 3)
Setup: 15,150 cells, 5 snapshots, 20 PCs of 4000 HVG; ICNN 3x64, energy MLP 2x64; inner loop 50-100 Adam steps, eps=1, tau=1 (Sec. 4.2, Appendix C)
